title: Binary value of a bit string
statement: For every natural number $L$ and every bit string $f$ indexed by the positions $0,1,\ldots,L-1$, the natural number represented by its image under the standard bijection between length-$L$ bit strings and integers from $0$ to $2^L-1$ is the value of the list of its bits, with the first list entry interpreted as the least significant bit.
